blur_detection.description: The receipt image is sharp with clear text definition and good edge clarity throughout.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed as text is clearly readable for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The receipt shows excellent contrast between dark text and light background with uniform lighting.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: No enhancement needed as contrast is sufficient for accurate text extraction.

glare_identification.description: No visible glare, reflections, or overexposed areas are present on the receipt.
glare_identification.recommendation: No action needed as image is free from glare issues.

water_stains.description: No water damage, discoloration, or staining is visible on the receipt.
water_stains.recommendation: No action needed as document is free from water damage.

tears_or_folds.description: Minor creasing visible in the central area of the receipt, but text remains fully legible.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: No action needed as the minor creasing does not impact text extraction.

cut_off_detection.description: All edges of the receipt are fully visible with complete content capture.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: No action needed as entire document is within frame.

missing_sections.description: All standard receipt sections are present including header, line items, totals, and footer.
missing_sections.recommendation: No action needed as receipt appears complete.

obstructions.description: No fingers, shadows, or other obstructions block any content on the receipt.
obstructions.recommendation: No action needed as image is free from obstructions.
